description: Browse Bazaraki.com category and subcategory ads, search by keyword, filter by district, price, bedrooms, condition and sort order, or fetch specific listing and search URLs.

bedrooms.description: Restrict Real Estate listings to this number of bedrooms. Ignored for categories that do not offer a bedroom filter.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms (Real Estate)

category.description: Browse one of Bazaraki's top-level categories, or all categories when a keyword is given.
category.title: Category (mode=search)

city.description: Restrict results to a Cyprus district.
city.title: District (mode=search)

condition.description: Restrict results to new, resale/used, or under-construction items where Bazaraki offers a condition filter (mainly Real Estate and some goods). `used` and `resale` mean the same thing.
condition.title: Condition

includeDetails.description: When on, fetches each listing's detail data for the full description, labeled characteristics, coordinates, seller profile, views/favorites and the complete photo gallery. Slower but much more complete.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full detail page per listing

maxPrice.description: Only keep listings priced at or below this amount (EUR; monthly rent for rentals).
maxPrice.title: Max price (EUR)

minPrice.description: Only keep listings priced at or above this amount (EUR; monthly rent for rentals).
minPrice.title: Min price (EUR)

mode.description: Search / browse listings, or fetch the exact listing and search URLs you already have.
enumTitles: Fetch specific listing or search URLs
mode.title: Mode

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword, e.g. `iphone`, `toyota`, `apartment`. Leave empty to browse a category unfiltered. Bazaraki caps keyword results at about 1,000 matches; use category + filters for complete lists.
searchQuery.title: Keyword (mode=search)

sortBy.description: How to order results. Bazaraki always shows paid VIP/TOP ads first within a page, then applies this order.
sortBy.title: Sort order (mode=search)

startUrls.description: Full Bazaraki listing URLs (e.g. `https://www.bazaraki.com/adv/6659275_iphone/`) and/or category or search URLs (filters are kept). A bare numeric ID cannot be fetched because Bazaraki's routing needs the URL's slug.
startUrls.title: Listing or search URLs (mode=byUrls)

subcategory.description: Drill into a Real Estate or Motors subcategory (property type or vehicle type). Overrides `category` when set.
